blocks.text: MINNEAPOLIS— Anthony Edwards has been spending as much time around the Minnesota Timberwolves as he can, with daily rehabilitation work — two sessions on game days — for his surgically repaired right knee. He’s still a constant presence in the group chat with his teammates, offering opponent scouting reports and all-around encouragement while wearing a knee brace that has not affected his wide smile.
